open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [BEHAVIOR] MUST validate the amount through validate_eur_amount with the portal currency EUR and strictly_positive=True before opening any transaction, so a FinancialValidationError changes nothing; payment_id is the replay identity: equal payment_id/content returns existing, conflict changes nothing, and a new payment plus AuditAction.PAYMENT_REGISTER audit commits atomically without creating an invoice/accounting posting.
open_points.other_text: - register_work_payment: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST rollback and re-raise every BaseException before commit; replay MUST rollback once and return without audit, while a successful commit MUST not be followed by rollback.
open_points.question: Must FinancialValidationError be raised before any transaction is opened, or is it exempt from the requirement to rollback every BaseException before commit?
